This is fixture text for the About opener. It exists only so the About template can be tested, it is built only when `CONTENT_SOURCE=fixtures` is set, and it says nothing true or false about anyone.

A second fixture paragraph, long enough to wrap across several lines beside the placeholder portrait at wide viewports and above it on narrow ones.
